title: Kathrine D Probable NDE 7872
content: In October of 2015, I had to undergo the removal of three lumps that were supposedly smaller than 2.5 cm in my right breast. During the placement of the leads, the local anesthesia was not numbing the area. Due to my breast being so dense, it was agreed that I would be given general anesthesia. The doctor informed me that the surgery would only be about 45 minutes and leave a slight scar less then 1' long that would heal into almost nothing. I remember telling the students in the operating room what I was having done, and then there was blackness. Suddenly I was in a clouded tunnel. To the most outside edge, the clouds were like dark storm clouds. The closer they were to me, the lighter they became so that next to me were bright white clouds. I was so interested in the clouds. I studied them, watching them rolling around me like a fun-house tunnel rotating around me. The difference was that I never got dizzy. I was strolling through the tunnel, like I was studying each cloud. I was not rushing, so there was no super speed. It was almost like being on a straight escalator but I knew my legs were walking. I was going forward, not up or down. I finally looked forward, and maybe 30 feet away in front of me was a figure standing in the light at the end of the tunnel. He had brown hair that was a little longer then shoulder length and a brown beard that came just to the top of his collar bone. I noticed he wore a white robe with an almost Roman or Greek red sash draping one shoulder and across his chest. I could not focus on his face. Although the beard was clear, his face was not. His arms were out towards me, as if he was wondering why I was there and why was I taking my time? I was like he was asking if was what I was expecting. I was not sure which he meant because he never spoke. I remember I tilted my head to the side and smiled at him. Then I felt myself being pulled back. I saw him act frantic, almost trying to reach a hand out to grab me, but he missed. As I was being pulled backwards, I saw him 'throw' a stack of color at me like a Frisbee. I felt like images and information were being downloaded into my brain. When I woke up from the 'download', the first thought I had were words I croaked, 'Oh my God, I died!' The nurse at the station came over immediately and told me to go back to sleep. I told her, 'No.' She again told me to try to go back to sleep as I was still coming out of anesthesia. Again I told her 'No.' I was fully aware, very much rested, and very interested in what I saw. So she sighed at me and asked if I was hungry and thirsty. I was starving. So she got my oldest daughter and my fiancée and brought me food. As soon as my fiancée made it through the curtain, I immediately told him what I saw. He looked at me and then told me, my 45 minute surgery lasted 2 hours. One of the lumps they removed was the size of a golf ball, and because of that, my under 1 inch cut was now almost 3 inches long. I immediately asked him if the surgeon said anything about me dying. He replied no. I looked right at him and told him point blank, without a doubt in my mind, that I did die. I don't care if it was just a slip of a heartbeat or if they decided not to tell anyone because they brought me back. I know I died. Now, I just want to know what the man in the tunnel downloaded to me and why he had seemed to have not wanted to let me go.

tunnel.movement_other_detail: She described 'strolling' and 'like being on a straight escalator' while knowing her legs were walking, moving forward (not up or down) and not at super speed.

arrival.religious_figure_detail: A male figure in light at the end of the tunnel with brown shoulder-length hair, brown beard, white robe, and a red sash draped over one shoulder and across his chest; face not in focus; arms out toward her; never spoke.

environment.environment_other_detail: A 'clouded tunnel' with clouds ranging from dark storm clouds at the outer edge to bright white clouds near her, rolling/rotating around her like a fun-house tunnel; light at the end.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Breast lump removal under general anesthesia after local anesthesia did not numb the area.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: A nonverbal encounter with a robed male figure at the light; then being pulled back and receiving a 'download' of images/information.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Blackness → clouded tunnel → figure in light at tunnel end → pulled backward → 'download' → awakening.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: The figure 'threw' a 'stack of color' like a Frisbee, experienced as images/information being 'downloaded' into her brain.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Oh my God, I died!”; “I know I died.”
